newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Amcorp to buy computer company.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Amcorp to buy computer company.

text.p: Malaysian financial and industry services group Arab-Malaysian Corporation Bhd (Amcorp) said it has proposed to acquire a 51 percent stake in a computer hardware and software distributor.
Amcorp said it was acquiring the stake in P.K. Technology Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of 7.6 million ringgit.
A statement by Amcorp to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday said the stake would be acquired by Amcorp's wholly-owned subsidiary Mezzanine Capital (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd (MCM).

"The proposed acquisition is in the ordinary course of business as MCM is a venture capital company which invests in small and medium sized companies with growth potential," Amcorp said in the statement.
Amcorp shares closed down 20 cents to 12.10 ringgit on Friday.
